patch.value: GH-942: expose the lightweight all-item metadata reader through the public SDK

GitHub issue https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/942 reports that listAllItemMetadataLight already powers the cheap CLI list path but is not exported through the public SDK, forcing package authors to choose heavier reads or private imports. Promote a typed, bounded public primitive with PmClient and narrow subpath parity.

A documented public SDK primitive exposes the lightweight all-item metadata read without importing CLI or private core modules; top-level, narrow subpath, PmClient, and runtime action contracts have intentional parity; return types and omission semantics distinguish intentionally unavailable fields; import-cost, token, package-boundary, surface-snapshot, and complete coverage gates pass; a package-authoring example proves use from a compiled external consumer

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text:
Evidence sharpening the GH-942 framing, measured 2026-08-09 at host 2026.8.9.

The issue describes listAllItemMetadataLight as unexported. The stronger statement is that it is already declared as public and is not exported. It appears in sdk/public-surface.json at line 6049, which is the file that declares the SDK's public surface, while src/sdk/index.ts does not export it. Its only importers are internal: src/sdk/history-compact.ts, src/sdk/schema.ts (five call sites) and src/sdk/schema-migration.ts.

So the gap is not an omission from a list — it is a disagreement between two declarations of the same surface. An author who consults the declared public surface finds the symbol, and an author who consults the entrypoint cannot import it. Whichever one is authoritative, the other is currently lying, and no gate compares them.

This is the same producer/consumer parity shape recorded on pm-doxj at horizon AG: the surface has a declaration with no export behind it. Adding the export closes the issue; adding a gate that fails when public-surface.json names a symbol the entrypoint does not export closes the class.

Related measurement from the same pass: pm-sr3xzg records that the light reader is also the one src/sdk/governance/validate.ts line 3654 declines to use, loading every item body unconditionally instead.
